title: Plans
snippet:
# Free: $0
For individuals getting started. Free is for one person, so there's no shared workspace.
- Unlimited meetings, up to 45 minutes each
- 30-day meeting history: older meetings are locked and unlock when you upgrade
- 5 manual uploads in total, each under 45 minutes
- AI notes and action items, real-time notes and live transcripts, clip creation
- Record with the bot, or without one using the desktop app
- Personal API and webhooks, Zapier, and Claude and ChatGPT through basic MCP
# Pro: $15 per month billed yearly, or $19 monthly
For individuals who've outgrown Free. Pro is also for one person.
- Unlimited meetings, up to 4 hours each
- Unlimited meeting history
- Unlimited uploads and imports, each under 3 hours
- Custom AI prompts and note templates, custom vocabulary
- No watermark
# Business: $29 per seat per month billed yearly, or $39 monthly
For companies sharing meeting memory and AI. Minimum 2 seats.
- Shared company workspace with admin controls, teams, and team libraries with custom recording and sharing rules
- Free Lite seats: invite teammates to watch, comment and clip
- Unlimited meetings up to 8 hours each; unlimited uploads, each under 3 hours
- Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce and Aircall, including CRM field autofill
- Conversation intelligence: AI coaching, trackers and talk-time metrics
- Custom AI follow-up emails
- Advanced MCP for Claude and ChatGPT; workspace API and webhooks. Learn more about Grain's MCP [here](https://support.grain.com/en/articles/14811968-how-to-use-the-grain-mcp-server).
- Recording consent, sensitive meeting detection and data retention policies
- Free data migration from other AI notetakers

title: Grain API
snippet:
The Grain API lets developers read meeting data, manage recordings, and receive real-time events from Grain programmatically. Use it to build custom integrations, sync data to internal systems, or automate workflows that go beyond what Grain's built-in integrations support.

**Personal Access Token (PAT)**: grants access on behalf of a single user. The token has the same permissions as the user who generated it. Best for personal automations or testing. Available on every plan, including Free. Click [here](https://grain.com/app/settings/account/integrations/personal_api) to generate a PAT.
**Workspace Access Token (WAT)**: grants access to all data in the workspace, regardless of which user owns it. Use this for server-side integrations where you need workspace-wide access. Requires admin access to generate and is available on Business and Enterprise plans. Click [here](https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api) to generate a WAT.

The API allows 300 requests per minute per token. Requests beyond this limit return a `429 Too Many Requests` response. Each response includes rate limit headers so you can track remaining capacity.

**Do I need a specific Grain plan to use the API?** Not for personal API access, which is available on every plan, including Free. Workspace API access is available on Business and Enterprise plans and requires admin access to generate.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
snippet: **A:** MCP integrations, including the Grain MCP server, are only available on paid Claude plans (Pro, Team, and Enterprise). Free Claude accounts do not support MCP integrations or the ability to connect external tools and data sources. You'll need to upgrade to a paid plan to access the Grain integration and other MCP servers.

title: Free Models are here. Try Grain free for 7 days.
snippet:
# Free Models are here. Try Grain free for 7 days.
Meet Space Bunny Alpha in Grain: a new way to brainstorm, draft, and explore with zero Grain credits. Start with a seven-day Grain trial, no credit card required.

Free Models is now available in Grain on web and desktop, starting with Space Bunny Alpha through OpenRouter. You do not need your own API key, and requests in this lane use zero Grain credits.
New to Grain? Start a seven-day free trial with no credit card. The trial lets you explore Grain; Free Models has its own request limits and provider availability. The two are separate, so the trial is not a promise of unlimited model usage or guaranteed access to an experimental model for seven days.

Free Models sits alongside Grain Models and Grain Executor. Grain Models uses workspace credits for broader hosted workflows. Grain Executor connects your own coding tools and computers for repository work. Free Models currently supports tasks you start yourself using text; it does not accept attachments or project context, run unattended automations, or provide repository access.
## Clear limits, no surprise switch to a paid model
Free requests have personal, workspace, task, and shared provider limits. One task can make several model requests. Grain shows availability in the app; if a limit is reached or the model is unavailable, the free task stops instead of silently switching to a paid model.
Space Bunny Alpha is an experimental model from an anonymous provider through OpenRouter. The provider may log or use prompts under its own terms, and model availability can change without notice. Use public, non-sensitive content; keep private, customer, and repository information out of Free Models.

title: Plans and limits
snippet:
GrainQL has three plans: Starter, Growth, and Scale. Every plan has every feature, Neo included. The plans differ by the number of visitors a month and by the data history. Events are unlimited on every plan.
##
​
Plans
| Plan | Price | Visitors a month | Data history | Support |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $29 a month, $290 a year | 50,000 | 12 months | Standard |
| Growth | $99 a month, $990 a year | 250,000 | 24 months | Priority |
| Scale | $299 a month, $2,990 a year | 1,000,000 | 36 months | Slack |
A yearly plan costs the price of 10 months. For more than 1,000,000 visitors a month, an Enterprise plan is sized with you. The current prices and the Enterprise contact are at [grainql.com/pricing](https://www.grainql.com/pricing). If this page and the pricing page disagree, the pricing page is correct. A visitor is one person who visits your site in a month. Every page view, click, and scroll of that person is included. There are no overage charges.
